headline: Tuesday slate: two NLDS elimination-pressure games (Dodgers @ Braves tied 1-1, Brewers @ Padres 2-0 MIL), Nations League (Croatia-Spain, England-Czechia), USMNT vs Canada, a 9-game NHL card, Southern Miss @ Troy, and a Baycurrent Classic preview. No WNBA today; Game 2s are Wednesday.

record.label: Last board (Fri 10/2)
record.note: Thursday's golf all hit (4-0, +3.45u). Running total: 27-26-1, +4.37u. Game totals are 0-7 across both boards, so today's board has none.

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and only one pick today is a 4.
No game totals today. They went 0-7 over the last two boards — a small sample, but they were also the picks with the thinnest research behind them.
Croatia-Spain and England-Czechia kick off at 11:45 AM PT. Bet those first or skip them.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. SGPs pay less than the multiplied odds shown.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges on today's card. Friday's Best of the Day went 3-5 (-2.09u); the Bruins and both props hit, and the totals and parlays didn't.

straight.reasoning: The biggest starting-pitcher gap on the board. Nick Pivetta posted a 1.45 ERA over four September starts after returning from injury, and San Diego won all four. Milwaukee's Dustin May has a 5.65 ERA in 10 starts since joining the Brewers. San Diego was 51-30 at Petco Park and swept Milwaukee there in August. Covers, SI and FanDuel Research all land on the Padres. Playable to -150.

Troy can't score enough to cover double digits. The Trojans average 21.3 points (130th nationally) and 3.9 yards per carry against FBS teams, and QB Goose Crowder is completing 52% of his passes. Troy is 0-2 against the spread as a 10.5+ point favorite. Southern Miss just lost 24-21 to Tulane. Take +11 if you can find it.

Croatia just lost 7-0 at home to England, is conceding 4.0 goals per game, and is missing defenders Martin Erlić and Josip Juranović. Spain is 3-0, averaging 3.33 goals and 7.33 shots on target per game. Spain is missing Nico Williams, Ferran Torres, Grimaldo and Eric García, which is why this is 0.75u. A 2+ goal Spain win pays.

parlay.title: Tuesday Three-Sport
parlay.reasoning: Three independent picks, each with its own case (see each sport's tab). Pays about 4.5-to-1. Three legs still means a long shot, so it's half a unit.

parlay.title: Safer Two-Legger
parlay.reasoning: England at home against a winless Czechia team is a heavy favorite: 16.3 shots per game against Czechia's 4.0. Adding them to the Padres adds little risk and moves the price close to even money.

props.reasoning: Pivetta had 4+ strikeouts in seven of eight starts this season and struck out four Cubs in just 3.1 innings in the Wild Card Series. Four strikeouts is the bar, even if San Diego pulls him early. Playable to -175.

Yamal has four goals and five shots on target in three Nations League games. With Nico Williams out, more of Spain's attack runs through him, against a Croatia defense that just conceded seven. Confirm he starts.

props.pick: Jack Quinn OVER 2.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: Quinn has 21 shot attempts in Buffalo's first two games and has played 19+ minutes in both, now in a top-six role. Last season he ranked 42nd among all forwards in shots on goal per 60 minutes. Price is an estimate.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: NLDS Game 3s: Dodgers @ Braves (tied 1-1; Yamamoto vs Sale) and Brewers @ Padres (MIL leads 2-0; May vs Pivetta). The ALDS is off today.

straight.reasoning: Pivetta had a 1.45 ERA over four September starts and San Diego won all four. May has a 5.65 ERA in 10 starts with Milwaukee. The Padres were 51-30 at home and swept the Brewers at Petco in August. Covers, SI and FanDuel Research all agree. Playable to -150.

Chris Sale (2.16 ERA, 30.9% strikeout rate) has held the Dodgers' current hitters to a .200 average over 153 career plate appearances, and he threw a 9-inning, 11-strikeout shutout of them in August. About 73% of tickets are on LA, yet the line hasn't moved toward the Dodgers — a sign of sharper money on Atlanta. SI likes the Dodgers' lineup depth, so this is 0.75u, not a full unit. Playable to -120.

parlay.title: NL Home Teams
parlay.reasoning: Both home teams have the better starting pitcher in the matchup. Pays about 2.6-to-1.

parlay.title: Pivetta Sets the Tone (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Pivetta is missing bats, San Diego is probably winning — these two go together. That correlation means the book will price the SGP lower than the multiplied odds.

props.reasoning: Pivetta had 4+ strikeouts in seven of eight starts this season, plus four in 3.1 innings in the Wild Card Series. Playable to -175.

Sale had 200 strikeouts in 162.2 innings and struck out 11 Dodgers in his August shutout. Be aware: he cleared 7.5 in only 12 of 27 starts (44%), roughly what +115 implies. Bet this only if you believe the Dodger history matters.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Tuesday night Sun Belt game: Southern Miss @ Troy. NFL is back Thursday.

straight.reasoning: Troy is 130th nationally in scoring (21.3 points per game), gets 3.9 yards per carry against FBS teams, and its QB completes 52% of his passes. A team that can't score shouldn't be laying double digits, and Troy is 0-2 ATS as a 10.5+ favorite. Southern Miss lost by 3 to Tulane last week. Take +11 if you find it.

sections.label: Soccer
sections.slate: Nations League at 11:45 AM PT: Croatia vs Spain, England vs Czechia. Friendly at 5:00 PM PT: USMNT vs Canada in St. Paul.

straight.reasoning: Croatia lost 7-0 at home to England on Saturday, is conceding 4.0 goals per game, and is missing defenders Erlić and Juranović. Spain is 3-0, scoring 3.33 goals per game. A 2-goal win is a better price than Spain's -376 moneyline.

England has 16.3 shots and 3.67 goals per game; Czechia has 4.0 shots per game and zero points. England is missing Rice, Rashford and Reece James, though, so a 3-goal margin is a real ask. Half unit at plus money.

The US has scored 2+ goals in five of seven friendlies this year, including 3-0 over Mexico, and is playing at home. Friendlies bring heavy rotation and second-half substitutions, so this is a half unit.

parlay.title: Nations League Margins
parlay.reasoning: Both favorites need to win comfortably at the same time, against the two leakiest defenses in the window. Pays almost 4-to-1. Quarter unit.

props.reasoning: Four goals in three Nations League games. With Nico Williams out, more chances go his way, against a defense that just conceded seven. Confirm he starts.
England's penalty taker and main finisher against a winless team that allows 2.33 goals per game. It's expensive, so it's a half unit, and it works better as a parlay leg.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Nine games, including Wild @ Sabres, Blues @ Blackhawks, Kraken @ Golden Knights, Mammoth @ Devils, and Islanders vs Rangers.

straight.reasoning: Chicago is without Connor Bedard. St. Louis comes in rested after shutting out Dallas 4-0 in its opener (Joel Hofer stopped 25). SI has the Blues as a best bet. Playable to -155.
Minnesota averages 3.5 goals per game and Buffalo allows 4.0. Minnesota has been strong as a road favorite in this matchup. At nearly a coin-flip price, the team with the better defense is the value.
Seattle has allowed 1.33 goals per game with a .940 save percentage. Vegas has allowed 2.67 with an .879 save percentage. Three games is a tiny sample, so it's a half unit at plus money.

parlay.title: Central Road Favorites
parlay.reasoning: Two road favorites, each facing a weak opponent: Chicago without Bedard, and a Buffalo defense allowing 4 goals per game. Pays about 2.4-to-1.

props.pick: Jack Quinn OVER 2.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: 21 shot attempts through two games, 19+ minutes each night, and a top-six role. He was 42nd among forwards in shots per 60 last season. Price is an estimate.

Byram quarterbacks Chicago's top power-play unit and starts two-thirds of his shifts in the offensive zone, and St. Louis has spent 8+ minutes a night shorthanded. Covers rates it at 44%; at +130 (43% implied) the edge is thin, so it's a quarter unit. Price is an estimate.

sections.label: Golf
sections.slate: Baycurrent Classic, Yokohama Country Club (Japan). 72 players, no cut. Round 1 tees off Wednesday evening PT, so bet before then. Schauffele (+1000) is the defending champ; Smotherman and Tom Kim withdrew.

straight.reasoning: Greyserman finished 2nd at this course in each of the last two years, including one shot behind Schauffele last October. Fit at a specific course carries over year to year, and with no cut he gets all four rounds. His outright is +5700; Top 10 is the steadier way to back that course form. Price is an estimate.

Bridgeman has three straight top-10 finishes, including a win at the Biltmore in Asheville, and the SportsLine model flags him at +2200 to win. Top 10 bets on his form continuing without needing a win. Price is an estimate.

props.reasoning: Echavarria won here in 2024 and added another top 10 at this course after that. At +9400 to win, a Top 20 on a course he knows is the value angle. Price is an estimate.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: No WNBA today. The semifinal Game 2s are Wednesday (Dream lead the Liberty 1-0; Valkyries lead the Aces 1-0) and will be on tomorrow's board. NBA preseason games aren't worth betting — starters play limited minutes.
